raw: [name="Ines"]Hoederer, I've brought along everyone who agreed to use the bones to retreat.
speaker: Ines
content: Hoederer, I've brought along everyone who agreed to use the bones to retreat.

raw: [name="Ines"]Most of them wouldn't be able to withstand the long journey—the old, the young, and more injured Sarkaz than you can count.
speaker: Ines
content: Most of them wouldn't be able to withstand the long journey—the old, the young, and more injured Sarkaz than you can count.

raw: [name="Ines"]W said, and I quote, 'Let them die if they want,' but the other members of her squad carried them here.
speaker: Ines
content: W said, and I quote, 'Let them die if they want,' but the other members of her squad carried them here.

raw: [name="Ines"]Somehow, she still has quite a few living subordinates—enough to maintain order within the Lifebone and watch over Ulšulah in captivity.
speaker: Ines
content: Somehow, she still has quite a few living subordinates—enough to maintain order within the Lifebone and watch over Ulšulah in captivity.

raw: [name="Ines"]So at least you won't have to worry about having no one to take the wheel if you accidentally die on the road.
speaker: Ines
content: So at least you won't have to worry about having no one to take the wheel if you accidentally die on the road.

speaker: Hoederer
content: ...Got it.

speaker: Ines
content: What are you waiting for?

raw: The Lifebone casts a shadow over the ruins of the battlefield.
content: The Lifebone casts a shadow over the ruins of the battlefield.

content: None of the Sarkaz raise their heads. They may already know of—or have grown accustomed to—the greater shadow that will soon envelop their kilometers-long procession.

raw: Most of them move slowly as they cross the trenches left behind by the high-speed battleships.
content: Most of them move slowly as they cross the trenches left behind by the high-speed battleships.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]I was just thinking... Look how long the line of soldiers is.
speaker: Hoederer
content: I was just thinking... Look how long the line of soldiers is.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]We've all traveled that road from Kazdel to Victoria before. We all know how long it is.
speaker: Hoederer
content: We've all traveled that road from Kazdel to Victoria before. We all know how long it is.

raw: [name="Ines"]But if the Victorians break their word and open fire on the retreating Sarkaz forces, there'll be nothing you can do about it.
speaker: Ines
content: But if the Victorians break their word and open fire on the retreating Sarkaz forces, there'll be nothing you can do about it.

speaker: Hoederer
content: Yes. That's how it's always been.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]Maybe not immediately, but after the signal we send to all of Terra, every nation will be forced to respond.
speaker: Hoederer
content: Maybe not immediately, but after the signal we send to all of Terra, every nation will be forced to respond.

speaker: Ines
content: Are you sure that will work?

raw: [name="Ines"]Such a blatant retreat back to Kazdel will probably cause many countries to panic.
speaker: Ines
content: Such a blatant retreat back to Kazdel will probably cause many countries to panic.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]But there really is no better way.
speaker: Hoederer
content: But there really is no better way.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]Our squad must continue to present the strongest possible front to all factions. The moment we lose the strength to wield our weapons, we'll be devoured without a trace.
speaker: Hoederer
content: Our squad must continue to present the strongest possible front to all factions. The moment we lose the strength to wield our weapons, we'll be devoured without a trace.

raw: [name="Hoederer"]The same goes for the new 'King of Sarkaz'.
speaker: Hoederer
content: The same goes for the new 'King of Sarkaz'.

speaker: Hoederer
content: We must seize the initiative here.

raw: The airship in the distance is faintly visible through the bones, and the ship's cannons remain locked in targeting mode.
content: The airship in the distance is faintly visible through the bones, and the ship's cannons remain locked in targeting mode.

raw: A massive Catastrophe cloud still hovers around the ship, following the Sarkaz forces as they retreat.
content: A massive Catastrophe cloud still hovers around the ship, following the Sarkaz forces as they retreat.

raw: [name="Ines"]But there's something else that's got me very worried.
speaker: Ines
content: But there's something else that's got me very worried.

raw: [name="Ines"]Are you sure it's a good idea to have W guard Manfred?
speaker: Ines
content: Are you sure it's a good idea to have W guard Manfred?

speaker: Hoederer
content: She's the best for the job.

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]The squad has reached its destination.
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: The squad has reached its destination.

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]The weather is clear, and visibility is good.
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: The weather is clear, and visibility is good.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Keep looking to the southeast.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Keep looking to the southeast.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]We've received the latest intelligence from the Ministry of Defense, which includes Kazdel's approximate coordinates.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: We've received the latest intelligence from the Ministry of Defense, which includes Kazdel's approximate coordinates.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Please closely monitor the Sarkaz army, to ensure their retreat home isn't a cover for another military maneuver.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Please closely monitor the Sarkaz army, to ensure their retreat home isn't a cover for another military maneuver.

speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Understood.

content: The officer does not, in fact, understand why he needs to monitor the Sarkaz.

raw: However, out of respect for his comrades, he sits in the reconnaissance vehicle and stares intently at the data being sent back by the drones.
content: However, out of respect for his comrades, he sits in the reconnaissance vehicle and stares intently at the data being sent back by the drones.
All is calm.

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]There's nothing unusual to report at the moment, sir. By the way—and I'm just making small talk—Maylander rarely sends someone of your status to liaise with the military.
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: There's nothing unusual to report at the moment, sir. By the way—and I'm just making small talk—Maylander rarely sends someone of your status to liaise with the military.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Heh, the Victorians think they've done a fine job covering up the disaster in Londinium.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Heh, the Victorians think they've done a fine job covering up the disaster in Londinium.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Maylander needs to investigate the situation before we have a talk with them.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Maylander needs to investigate the situation before we have a talk with them.

speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Understood.

speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: ...Lieutenant! Lieutenant!

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]You are to report any new developments immediately!
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: You are to report any new developments immediately!

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]Of course, sir. There's nothing to report right now.
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Of course, sir. There's nothing to report right now.

speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Nothing at all?!

speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Wait. What's that...?

content: The officer puts down the communicator. The Catastrophe detection system on the vehicle is blaring an alarm.

content: He looks toward the capital district, but at this distance, he can barely make out the outline of the nomadic city.

raw: But he can clearly see the massive shadow cast by the Catastrophe cloud, stretching from above the capital district all the way to where he stands.
content: But he can clearly see the massive shadow cast by the Catastrophe cloud, stretching from above the capital district all the way to where he stands.

raw: [name="Respectful Attendant"]Yes. He knows you are familiar with the people of Siracusa, so he hopes you'll have a chance to display your talents this time.
speaker: Respectful Attendant
content: Yes. He knows you are familiar with the people of Siracusa, so he hopes you'll have a chance to display your talents this time.

raw: [name="Leithanian Noble"]Not to worry. The Sarkaz hordes are a chaotic, calamitous force, but they are ultimately mercenaries.
speaker: Leithanian Noble
content: Not to worry. The Sarkaz hordes are a chaotic, calamitous force, but they are ultimately mercenaries.

raw: [name="Leithanian Noble"]We are now well aware that our neighbor, Victoria, has failed to keep them on a tight leash.
speaker: Leithanian Noble
content: We are now well aware that our neighbor, Victoria, has failed to keep them on a tight leash.

raw: [name="Leithanian Noble"]But I shall not allow such filth to disrupt Leithanien's glorious Güldenesgesatz. Of this I am quite certain.
speaker: Leithanian Noble
content: But I shall not allow such filth to disrupt Leithanien's glorious Güldenesgesatz. Of this I am quite certain.

raw: [name="Leithanian Noble"]Please send this message along to your master—
speaker: Leithanian Noble
content: Please send this message along to your master—

raw: The noble is interrupted by a suddenly darkening sky.
content: The noble is interrupted by a suddenly darkening sky.

speaker: Leithanian Noble
content: ...What's going on?

raw: [name="Respectful Attendant"]Come inside with me now, sir! It's a Catastrophe!
speaker: Respectful Attendant
content: Come inside with me now, sir! It's a Catastrophe!

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]Contact the base for further orders... Damn! We've got no signal! What the hell is going on? Push the fleet forward. Full throttle!
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Contact the base for further orders... Damn! We've got no signal! What the hell is going on? Push the fleet forward. Full throttle!

speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Wait—

raw: The data from the Catastrophe detection system sends a chill down his spine.
content: The data from the Catastrophe detection system sends a chill down his spine.

raw: The cloud has stopped expanding, just as suddenly as it had appeared a few minutes ago.
content: The cloud has stopped expanding, just as suddenly as it had appeared a few minutes ago.

raw: The strong wind blows Originium dust up into the sky, but it doesn't fall back down.
content: The strong wind blows Originium dust up into the sky, but it doesn't fall back down.

raw: Then the cloud starts to dissipate as the sunlight peaks through.
content: Then the cloud starts to dissipate as the sunlight peaks through.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Can you hear me, lieutenant?
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Can you hear me, lieutenant?

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]Yes, sir! The Catastrophe cloud appeared out of nowhere. There were no signs at all before it happened...
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: Yes, sir! The Catastrophe cloud appeared out of nowhere. There were no signs at all before it happened...

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Of course, of course. This was meant as a display, a show of force to intimidate us.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Of course, of course. This was meant as a display, a show of force to intimidate us.

raw: [name="Columbian Military Officer"]You think the Sarkaz troops did this...?!
speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: You think the Sarkaz troops did this...?!

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]Maylander no longer requires your help with our investigation. Please withdraw at once. Of course, do not disclose any information about our cooperation.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: Maylander no longer requires your help with our investigation. Please withdraw at once. Of course, do not disclose any information about our cooperation.

speaker: Columbian Military Officer
content: ...Yes sir.

raw: [name="Voice from the Communicator"]May Terra bless us.
speaker: Voice from the Communicator
content: May Terra bless us.

raw: [name="Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief"]Enough. Deactivate the tip line. We have more than enough eyewitness accounts of the Catastrophe cloud!
speaker: Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief
content: Enough. Deactivate the tip line. We have more than enough eyewitness accounts of the Catastrophe cloud!

speaker: Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief
content: Everyone saw what happened. Those of us living in the high rises got an even closer look!

raw: [name="Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief"]For now, I need all of you to come up with explanations and file your stories. Everyone writes a report—whether you explain it away as an advertising hologram or new Arts from Leithanien, that's up to you.
speaker: Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief
content: For now, I need all of you to come up with explanations and file your stories. Everyone writes a report—whether you explain it away as an advertising hologram or new Arts from Leithanien, that's up to you.

speaker: Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief
content: ...Do you need anything else?

raw: [name="Kazimierzian Staff Member"]Sir, this call wasn't from a citizen...
speaker: Kazimierzian Staff Member
content: Sir, this call wasn't from a citizen...

raw: [name="Kazimierzian Staff Member"]We just received word from our Messengers... Zwillingstürme, Laterano, Montelupe... Catastrophe clouds have appeared over the capitals of every nation.
speaker: Kazimierzian Staff Member
content: We just received word from our Messengers... Zwillingstürme, Laterano, Montelupe... Catastrophe clouds have appeared over the capitals of every nation.

raw: [name="Kazimierzian Editor-in-Chief"]What about Deity Grypherburg and Max D.C.?

content: What about Deity Grypherburg and Max D.C.?

content: ...Same situation.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]That little 'Amnannam' thingamajig is pretty handy. It can send a Catastrophe to someone's doorstep before you can blink.

content: That little 'Amnannam' thingamajig is pretty handy. It can send a Catastrophe to someone's doorstep before you can blink.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Tch, no wonder Doctor and the hag were so nervous when we came to take it away, and the little bunny insisted on tagging along to keep an eye on me.
speaker: Wiš'adel
content: Tch, no wonder Doctor and the hag were so nervous when we came to take it away, and the little bunny insisted on tagging along to keep an eye on me.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Hmm...What if we just, like, destroyed every capital of the Core all at once?
speaker: Wiš'adel
content: Hmm...What if we just, like, destroyed every capital of the Core all at once?

raw: [name="???"]While it may indeed be able to rain down disaster on those nations, that doesn't mean it can destroy them.
content: While it may indeed be able to rain down disaster on those nations, that doesn't mean it can destroy them.

raw: [name="???"]I have no doubt that doing so would bring nothing but retaliation against Kazdel. Our history has repeatedly proven this, even from the earliest records.
content: I have no doubt that doing so would bring nothing but retaliation against Kazdel. Our history has repeatedly proven this, even from the earliest records.

raw: [name="???"]It would be unwise, Wiš'adel. In fact, you must use Amnannam sparingly—the strain it places on the mind and body is even greater than I imagined.
content: It would be unwise, Wiš'adel. In fact, you must use Amnannam sparingly—the strain it places on the mind and body is even greater than I imagined.
You just experienced that pain firsthand.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]You don't get to tell me that, Manfred.

content: You don't get to tell me that, Manfred.

speaker: Manfred
content: Amnannam's potential extends far beyond intimidation, assuming we figure out the proper use for it.

raw: [name="Manfred"]Their Highnesses had much higher hopes for it. Yes, it is a weapon, a deterrent, but more importantly, it is the means by which we will break free from our destiny—

content: Their Highnesses had much higher hopes for it. Yes, it is a weapon, a deterrent, but more importantly, it is the means by which we will break free from our destiny—

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]You know, you're even more annoying than Hoederer.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Don't forget who you are, dude. You're a prisoner, and we're only keeping you alive 'cause Kazdel needs you alive.

content: Don't forget who you are, dude. You're a prisoner, and we're only keeping you alive 'cause Kazdel needs you alive.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Hell, the only reason we let the Military Commission stick around is that the surviving Sarkaz still need something to believe in on the way home.

content: Hell, the only reason we let the Military Commission stick around is that the surviving Sarkaz still need something to believe in on the way home.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Fucking Theresis sure thought of everything, huh?
speaker: Wiš'adel
content: Fucking Theresis sure thought of everything, huh?

raw: [name="Manfred"]...I'm guessing Hoederer saw this coming long ago too, didn't he?
speaker: Manfred
content: ...I'm guessing Hoederer saw this coming long ago too, didn't he?

raw: [name="Manfred"]This was always the Regent's overt strategy: to reunite a people—brought together once more by hatred—around Kazdel—
speaker: Manfred
content: This was always the Regent's overt strategy: to reunite a people—brought together once more by hatred—around Kazdel—

raw: [name="Manfred"]Even Babel and the Military Commission are working together again, united toward a common goal.
speaker: Manfred
content: Even Babel and the Military Commission are working together again, united toward a common goal.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Yeah yeah, but don't expect to wriggle your way out of this one, Manfred. Remember what I said.

content: Yeah yeah, but don't expect to wriggle your way out of this one, Manfred. Remember what I said.

speaker: Manfred
content: Wiš'adel...

speaker: Wiš'adel
content: What, still got more to say?

raw: [name="Manfred"]If, someday, Kazdel really does normalize its relations with the other nations, just as Her Highness Theresa once strived for...
speaker: Manfred
content: If, someday, Kazdel really does normalize its relations with the other nations, just as Her Highness Theresa once strived for...

raw: [name="Manfred"]Then I, along with the rest of the Military Commission, will have to draw a clear line between ourselves and Kazdel.

content: Then I, along with the rest of the Military Commission, will have to draw a clear line between ourselves and Kazdel.

raw: [name="Manfred"]As the Sarkaz see it, outbloods bring only pain and hatred, just as we do to them.

content: As the Sarkaz see it, outbloods bring only pain and hatred, just as we do to them.

raw: [name="Manfred"]Sooner or later, they will claim that we haven't paid for the crimes we have committed, and on that day I will be waiting for those hateful avengers to find us—

content: Sooner or later, they will claim that we haven't paid for the crimes we have committed, and on that day I will be waiting for those hateful avengers to find us—

content: Just shut up already. Stop acting like you're a saint or whatever.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Theresis and the rest of you assholes screwed up big time. You were so goddamned stupid I wish I could blow you to pieces right now.

content: Theresis and the rest of you assholes screwed up big time. You were so goddamned stupid I wish I could blow you to pieces right now.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Don't forget: almost all the lunatics who actually believed in your plan died in Londinium, along with the Nachzehrer.

content: Don't forget: almost all the lunatics who actually believed in your plan died in Londinium, along with the Nachzehrer.

content: You killed them with your own hands. There were hardly any left to even evacuate.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]But the Sarkaz will pay for their own mistakes.

content: But the Sarkaz will pay for their own mistakes.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Babel's not so spineless as to cast the entire Commission from the city just because a few dumbasses were bold enough to provoke Kazdel.

content: Babel's not so spineless as to cast the entire Commission from the city just because a few dumbasses were bold enough to provoke Kazdel.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]Her Highness would never do that, and neither will I.

content: Her Highness would never do that, and neither will I.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]If they're stupid enough to come, I don't mind giving 'em a fight.

raw: [name="Wiš'adel"]But if you keep talking shit, I'll just toss you over to someone who's willing to put up with your crap.

content: You're not afraid of it?

content: Look at that moving Catastrophe cloud over there. It seems so far away, but I can't shake the feeling it might suddenly appear right above my head...

content: But there's a trick I picked up in Sami: whenever I'm scared, I just pull my hat over my head, crouch down, and think of something happy. The things you're afraid of will disappear before you even know it.

content: After all, I'm just minding my own business—they wouldn't give me a hard time for no reason, would they?

content: Just last week you said you'd lost count of how many times you'd been captured and interrogated by one of the Famiglie.

raw: [name="Mysterious Man"]*sigh* I'm sorry for the trouble.

content: *sigh* I'm sorry for the trouble.

content: But misunderstandings always get cleared up in the end. I mean, you guys did let me go, didn't you?

content: ...I really can't figure out how you managed to make it all the way through Sami and Ursus in one piece. You ain't lying about that too, are ya?
